en: Black-and-white panoramic view over a coastal city looking toward the sea and distant mountains. A straight central street lined with low buildings and tiled roofs leads down to the waterfront, with pedestrians, carts and early automobiles visible. In the foreground to the right is a church facade with a bell tower and three crosses. Printed captions in Greek and French appear below the image, along with a small reference number.
